newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hog prices seen steady - dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hog prices seen steady - dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Wednesday were seen steady, but could fluctuate depending on how and if the weather influences marketings, livestock dealers said.
Prices could rise in areas where cold weather still curbs runs and weaken where road conditions and temperatures improve enough to allow producers to sort and ship more hogs.
Interior Iowa/southern Minnesota top hog prices at the plant could range $56.00 to $57.00, sources there said.
Illinois sources said top prices at plants could range $54.50 to $55.00.
Indiana/Ohio sources said top prices at the plant could range $55.00 to $55.50.
Several packers reportedly bought just enough hogs for Wednesday operations and pulled back from the market amid anticipation of lower prices on Thursday, dealers said.
Hog marketings were expected larger by Thursday if weather conditions improve, they said.
Forecasts called for light snow over the Corn Belt on Wednesday, with an inch or two possible, with temperatures seen below to much below normal, Weather Services Corp said.
